purpose: Require explicit bounded human promotion evidence before any successor release-attestation authority becomes active.
rules: The bootstrap sequence-1 authority predates this control and has no promotion receipt.
Every lineage entry after sequence 1 references exactly one immutable promotion receipt by repository path and Git blob SHA.
The receipt binds the immediate predecessor authority SHA, successor authority SHA and successor workflow blob SHA.
All required review controls are explicitly true; missing or false controls fail closed.
The reviewer id and review summary are explicit bounded human-authored fields and may not use the reserved shine-defence-core machine authority.
approvedAt must be valid and no later than the lineage activatedAt timestamp.
Changing a receipt changes its Git blob fingerprint and invalidates the lineage until the exact replacement is deliberately rebound.
limitations: A repository receipt proves explicit recorded authorization and byte identity; it does not independently prove the real-world identity of the named reviewer.
This control supplements repository branch/ruleset protections rather than replacing them.
